CustomObject.description: Durable sink for outbound-integration failures. Logger.logApiException persists one row per failure (system-mode insert) carrying an allowlist-scrubbed diagnostic summary — status code, endpoint host+path, correlation id, exception type — never raw request or response bodies. LogCleanupBatch purges rows past the Log_Clean_Up__mdt retention window unless Do_Not_Delete__c is checked.
CustomObject.label: API Exception Log
